bestCandidate.label: Combined lane spacing v2
bestCandidate.intent: Increase dive-lane separation while preserving scheduled fire and projectile motion.

promotionGate.read: Candidate clears the measurement gate for browser/contact-sheet review, but it remains analysis-only.

candidateStageFiveClosenessEstimate.read: Candidate analysis estimates stage-five closeness would move from 6.8/10 to about 7.3/10 before runtime refresh.

alienShipPaceComparison.read: Candidate analysis slows/lengthens alien path commitment while preserving enemy missile velocity, enemy missile cadence, and player single-shot cadence.

visualVerdict.read: Combined lane spacing v2 improves aggregate readability, routeability, lane overlap, and collision metrics, but the fixed contact-sheet overlap sample does not improve, so this pass should not promote runtime behavior yet.

promotionDecision.read: Hold runtime promotion. Keep the candidate as a measured improvement and resolve the fixed contact-sheet overlap regression before changing shipped behavior.

nextSteps: Do not promote the current candidate constants into runtime yet.
